sourceEvidence.text: NIA registration is due within 30 days counted from the day after the change. A new employer may also require work authorization, and a change in the basis for residence may require a separate application. Updating the address or workplace record does not complete those procedures.

Can you stay until the expiry date printed on your Alien Resident Certificate (ARC) if the job, course or family relationship supporting it ends sooner? Immigration Act Article 31 requires the National Immigration Agency (NIA) to revoke residence permission and cancel the card when the reason for residence disappears, subject to the statutory grounds on which NIA may approve continued residence.
Within 30 days counted from the day after the change.
Change of residence reason qualifying under Immigration Act Article 23-1
Application to NIA within 30 days from the event date.
Change of residence reason outside Article 23-1
The residence regulations prescribe a new resident-visa application to BOCA within 15 days from the event, followed by the NIA residence application.

Immigration Act Article 31 governs address and workplace registration; Articles 7 and 9 of the residence regulations govern changes of residence reason and extensions. Address changes are counted from the following day, while the regulations count a change of residence reason from the event date.

Standard extension fees are NT$1,000 per year of approved validity; a shorter period is charged as one year under Article 3 of the immigration permit fee standards. The residence category determines the period NIA may approve. Paying for a longer period does not create an entitlement to it.

Already past expiry? Contact NIA immediately. Article 31 allows a limited reapplication after a penalty when the overstay is less than 30 days and the original residence reason continues. That provision leaves the original expiry date unchanged; it is not an ordinary grace period.

A move requires new address evidence and NIA registration within the 30-day period. Updating a bank, university or employer's records does not complete the immigration registration required by Article 31. Keep the dated submission record.

For a new employer or an additional job, Employment Service Act Article 53 sets requirements that differ by worker category. The new work must be covered by the applicable permit or exemption before it begins. An NIA address or workplace update does not itself authorize that employment.

After graduation, termination of employment or a family-status change, an ARC holder may apply for a new residence basis under Immigration Act Article 23-1 only in the situations that provision lists.

Continued residence may also be available under Article 31, including specified circumstances involving a deceased family sponsor, domestic violence, children in Taiwan, labor litigation or an occupational injury. Each ground has its own conditions, so a divorce or employment dispute alone does not establish either a right to remain or an inevitable obligation to leave.

Qualifying professionals can seek the extension in Foreign Professionals Act Article 17. If approved, it runs for six months from the day after the original ARC or Gold Card expires. One further extension is available, up to a total of one year. Apply before expiry. Graduates have a different extension framework under Article 11 of the residence regulations, with eligibility tied to the completed program; the professional timetable does not apply to every student.

NIA's guide lists the damaged card, a loss declaration, a police report or other evidence as appropriate when an ARC is lost or damaged. Article 7 of the fee standards sets the standard replacement fee at NT$500. Replacing the card does not extend residence.

Re-entry requires valid permission under Immigration Act Article 34. Article 20 of the residence regulations ties that permission to the ARC's validity period and cancels it when the ARC is canceled. The permission recorded with the card therefore needs to cover the intended return date, along with the passport and residence status.

Legal sources checked October 24, 2026. This guide describes foreign-national procedures and category-specific exceptions, without determining an individual case. Mainland China residents, Hong Kong and Macau residents, and ROC nationals without household registration follow separate frameworks.

Изменилось основание для проживания и случай подпадает под статью 23-1 Закона об иммиграции
Обратиться в NIA в течение 30 дней со дня события.
Изменилось основание для проживания, но статья 23-1 к этому случаю не применяется
Правила предусматривают обращение за новой резидентской визой в Бюро консульских дел (BOCA) в течение 15 дней со дня события, затем — заявление о проживании в NIA.

Регистрацию адреса и места работы регулирует статья 31 Закона об иммиграции, а изменение основания и продление — статьи 7 и 9 правил пребывания и проживания иностранцев. Начальные даты различаются. Для адреса отсчёт идёт со следующего дня, для изменения основания — со дня самого события.

Стандартный сбор за продление составляет 1 000 новых тайваньских долларов за каждый год одобренного срока; период менее года оплачивается как год. Это установлено статьёй 3 правил иммиграционных сборов. Возможную продолжительность определяет категория проживания. Сама оплата более длительного срока права на него не даёт.

Срок уже истёк? Свяжитесь с NIA сразу. Статья 31 допускает ограниченную возможность повторного оформления после применения штрафной санкции, когда просрочка составляет менее 30 дней и прежнее основание для проживания сохраняется. Первоначальная дата окончания при этом не меняется. Обычного льготного периода после неё эта норма не создаёт.

После переезда понадобятся доказательство нового адреса и регистрация изменения в NIA в пределах указанного 30-дневного срока. Сообщение банку, университету или работодателю не выполняет требование иммиграционной регистрации по статье 31. Сохраните подтверждение подачи с датой.

При смене работодателя или дополнительной работе применяются требования статьи 53 Закона о службе занятости, которые различаются для разных категорий работников. До начала новой работы на неё должно распространяться соответствующее разрешение или законное освобождение от его получения. Обновление адреса либо места работы в NIA само по себе работать не разрешает.

Обладатель ARC может подать заявление о новом основании после окончания учёбы, прекращения трудовых отношений или изменения семейного положения только в случаях, перечисленных в статье 23-1 Закона об иммиграции. Наличие ещё действующей карты не делает эту процедуру доступной при любом изменении обстоятельств.

Дальнейшее проживание может быть разрешено и по статье 31. Она охватывает определённые обстоятельства, связанные со смертью родственника, через которого оформлено проживание, домашним насилием, детьми на Тайване, трудовым судебным спором или производственной травмой. У каждого основания есть собственные условия. Поэтому сам по себе развод или спор с работодателем ещё не определяет ни право остаться, ни неизбежность отъезда.

Подпадающие под требования иностранные специалисты могут обратиться за продлением по статье 17 Закона о привлечении и найме иностранных специалистов. При одобрении оно действует шесть месяцев со дня, следующего за окончанием прежней ARC или Gold Card. Допускается ещё одно продление, а общая продолжительность ограничена одним годом. Заявление подают до окончания действующего срока. Для выпускников предусмотрена другая процедура в статье 11 правил проживания; право на неё зависит от завершённой программы обучения. Сроки для специалистов нельзя переносить на всех студентов.

В зависимости от обстоятельств утраты или повреждения ARC инструкция предусматривает повреждённую карту, заявление об утрате, полицейский документ либо другое доказательство. Стандартный сбор за замену составляет 500 новых тайваньских долларов по статье 7 правил сборов. Замена карты срок проживания не продлевает.

Статья 34 Закона об иммиграции требует оформить разрешение на повторный въезд до выезда; для обладателей постоянного разрешения на проживание в ней предусмотрено исключение. По статье 20 правил проживания срок такого разрешения связан со сроком ARC, а аннулирование карты прекращает и разрешение на повторный въезд. Поэтому на планируемую дату возвращения должны действовать соответствующее разрешение, паспорт и статус проживания.

По правилам онлайн-процедуры NIA для иностранных специалистов и их семей при выезде заявителя из Тайваня во время рассмотрения агентство прекращает рассмотрение заявления. После нового въезда можно подать заявление заново, если заявитель отвечает условиям пункта 2 этой инструкции. Это правило касается только указанной онлайн-процедуры.

Правовые источники проверены 24 октября 2026 года. Материал описывает процедуры для иностранных граждан и исключения для отдельных категорий, но не определяет исход конкретного дела. Для жителей материкового Китая, Гонконга и Макао, а также граждан Китайской Республики без регистрации домохозяйства действуют отдельные правила.

sourceHints.text: Can you stay until the expiry date printed on your Alien Resident Certificate (ARC) if the job, course or family relationship supporting it ends sooner? Immigration Act Article 31 requires the National Immigration Agency (NIA) to revoke residence permission and cancel the card when the reason for residence disappears, subject to the statutory grounds on which NIA may approve continued residence.

Some programs allow an earlier renewal application. A qualifying entrepreneur ARC extension for a continuing Taiwan business can be filed during the four months before expiry. The separate continued-residence route after that business ceases has a three-month advance window. Gold Card renewal opens four months before expiry.

An ordinary extension requires the form, passport, existing ARC, photograph and current evidence of the reason for residence. NIA's guide calls for employment, study or family documents as appropriate, plus new address evidence if you have moved.

Continued residence may also be available under Article 31, including specified circumstances involving a deceased family sponsor, domestic violence, children in Taiwan, labor litigation or an occupational injury. Each ground has its own conditions, so a divorce or employment dispute alone does not establish either a right to remain or an inevitable obligation to leave.

An initial email to Hovering International Law Firm at wei@hoveringlaw.com.tw about an employment or family dispute affecting residence should state the event and relevant dates. Leave passport numbers and original identity documents out of that message.

A renewed passport requires a corresponding update to NIA's records, as its passport-renewal FAQ explains. For a data change, NIA's checklist requires the application, photograph, passport and evidence of the change. Keeping the old passport or a copy helps connect the old and new records.

Loss abroad also affects the return journey. Before attempting to travel back, contact NIA and the relevant Taiwan overseas mission with your passport details, an ARC copy if available, and intended return date. They can identify which document your circumstances require.

Re-entry requires valid permission under Immigration Act Article 34. Article 20 of the residence regulations ties that permission to the ARC's validity period and cancels it when the ARC is canceled. The permission recorded with the card therefore needs to cover the intended return date, along with the passport and residence status.

Legal sources checked October 24, 2026. This guide describes foreign-national procedures and category-specific exceptions, without determining an individual case. Mainland China residents, Hong Kong and Macau residents, and ROC nationals without household registration follow separate frameworks.
NIA, new immigrant FAQs, questions 2 and 3: card loss and passport updates.
Taiwan overseas mission directory: offices for overseas inquiries.
Passport updates and replacement cards

The general extension window opens three months before authorized residence expires. Gold Card renewal and qualifying entrepreneur ARC extensions for a continuing Taiwan business have separate four-month windows. These are advance filing periods, not grace periods after expiry.
Can I return to Taiwan with an ARC renewal receipt?

A receipt should not be assumed to replace the required travel documents. Before departure, ask NIA what document covers your return if the renewed card is still pending. Your passport, residence status and re-entry permission must cover the journey.

ARC pertama Taiwan: tempoh, dokumen dan yuran
Tempoh memohon ARC pertama bergantung pada cara anda masuk ke Taiwan. Dokumen, saluran permohonan dan pengambilan kad pula mengikut tujuan kediaman.
Buku dokumen perjalanan tanpa tanda, fail dokumen dan kad kecil kosong di atas meja permohonan
Adegan rekaan
Bilakah tempoh memohon ARC pertama mula dikira?

Jika anda masuk dengan visa kediaman dan mendapat kebenaran menetap, tempoh 30 hari bermula pada hari selepas ketibaan. Jika visa kediaman dikeluarkan selepas anda berada di Taiwan, BOCA mengira 30 hari dari tarikh visa itu dikeluarkan. Pemegang visa lawatan atau orang yang masuk tanpa visa mesti memenuhi kelayakan dan tempoh permohonan kategori kediaman masing-masing.
Berapakah yuran ARC pertama?

Yuran biasa ialah NT$1,000 bagi setiap tahun tempoh sah yang diluluskan; tempoh kurang daripada setahun tetap dikenakan yuran setahun. Permohonan kediaman selepas masuk tanpa visa atau dengan visa lawatan dikenakan tambahan NT$2,200 di bawah peraturan yuran. Pengurangan atau pengecualian tertentu bergantung pada status pemohon.
Bolehkah saya mula bekerja sebaik sahaja menerima ARC?

Hanya jika pekerjaan dan majikan berkenaan diliputi permit atau pengecualian yang terpakai kepada anda. ARC membuktikan kebenaran menetap. Kad itu sendiri tidak memberikan hak untuk melakukan semua jenis pekerjaan.

sourcePassages.text: Thirty days is the filing period for your first Alien Resident Certificate (ARC) if you enter Taiwan on a resident visa and receive residence permission. Count from the day after arrival. Immigration Act Article 22 requires the application to the National Immigration Agency (NIA), which issues the card as evidence of approved residence.

Visitors have a different starting point: they must qualify for a permitted change to residence before they can apply. Holding a valid combined document with ARC functions, such as an Employment Gold Card, removes the need for a separate card under the exception in Article 22.
Your visa and entry record determine the deadline. Someone who receives a resident visa while already in Taiwan uses a different starting date from someone who arrives with one.
Entry and visa status
When to apply
Entered with a resident visa
Within 30 days counted from the day after entry.
Received a resident visa after arriving in Taiwan
Within 30 days from the resident visa's issuance date, under BOCA's guidance.
Entered visa-exempt or with a visitor visa
Before the permitted stay expires, subject to the eligibility and filing rules for the residence category.

NIA's residence guide and BOCA's resident-visa guidance explain the first two situations. For eligible professionals, Article 16 of the Act for the Recruitment and Employment of Foreign Professionals permits a direct NIA residence application after visitor-visa or visa-exempt entry, with work authorization or an applicable exemption. Eligibility is specific to that route; the work, study and family comparison explains the conditions for other applicants.

An application based on a resident visa needs the form, photograph, passport and resident visa, evidence of the reason for residence, and proof of your current address, according to NIA's checklist. Bring the required originals and copies. A lease is one accepted address document.
The supporting evidence depends on why you are staying:
Employment: the relevant work approval and a certificate of employment issued within the preceding month, or evidence of the applicable exemption.
Degree study: an admission letter before registration, or recent enrollment evidence once registered.
Family residence: marriage or birth records proving the relationship, together with the sponsoring family member's identity or residence documents.

For a first application through marriage to a Taiwan national with household registration, the Taiwan spouse must attend. NIA also requires proof that the marriage is registered in Taiwan and gives the first spouse-based card one-year validity. These requirements appear in the NIA guide; the Taiwan-spouse residence article covers the family documents in more detail.

Certificates issued abroad may take longer to prepare than the application form. NIA requires authentication of overseas documents and may ask for a Chinese translation verified or notarized in the prescribed manner. The Taiwan overseas mission responsible for the place of issue can explain the authentication procedure. Police certificates and health examinations depend on the particular visa or residence category; they are not required in every first-card application.

NIA's residence application directory separates general residence applications from those for professionals and their dependents, students, and migrant workers. Each category has a designated online system or service-center procedure. Using the professional-worker system is appropriate only if your employment category belongs there.

Students use a dedicated online procedure. For the ordinary in-person application, the relevant NIA service center is the one covering your current address; NIA specifically directs Taiwan-spouse applications there in its residence guide.
Keep the submission record and uploaded documents. If NIA requests further evidence, retaining the request with the original file makes it clear which documents still need to be supplied.

Standard ARC fees are NT$1,000 for each year of approved validity, with a period under one year charged as a full year. Article 3 of the immigration permit fee standards adds NT$2,200 for applications following visa-exempt or visitor-visa entry. Its reduction for overseas compatriot students applies to that status, not to international students generally.

NIA decides the approved term. The ordinary statutory maximum is three years, while qualifying specialist professionals have a separate maximum under their legislation (Immigration Act Article 22; Foreign Professionals Act Article 8). Paying a higher fee cannot establish eligibility for a longer period.

For general applications, NIA gives a processing time of ten working days, excluding document return, requests for additional documents and interviews. The processing period starts again after the additional documents are submitted. Online categories have their own schedules, which may affect travel plans while the application is pending.

Under the student online procedure, payment is due within five working days from approval. A student collecting a smart-chip ARC must print the online payment receipt and take it to the selected NIA service center three working days after payment. That timetable applies to this student procedure; other applicants should follow the method and identification requirements in their approval or collection notice.

Check the issued card against your application. The name, passport details, address and residence expiry date should match the approved particulars; keep the receipt and decision with your immigration records.

An ARC alone does not authorize every job. Before starting work, the relevant permit or exemption must cover the actual employment under Employment Service Act Articles 43 and 48. Once you have the card, its expiry date and any later changes to your address or employment determine the next filings; travel may also require attention to re-entry permission. Those situations are covered in the renewal and changes guide.

Sources checked October 24, 2026. This procedural guide concerns foreign nationals and does not determine individual eligibility. Mainland China residents, Hong Kong and Macau residents, and ROC nationals without household registration follow separate frameworks.

NIA, residence, extension and change applications, updated April 14, 2026: documents, fees, processing and spouse attendance.
BOCA, resident visas for professional employees: ARC timing following resident visa issuance in Taiwan.
Act for the Recruitment and Employment of Foreign Professionals, Articles 8 and 16: specialist validity and direct residence applications.
NIA, residence application directory: category-specific application channels.
NIA, student online applications, updated August 28, 2026: student filing, payment and collection.
Taiwan overseas mission directory: document authentication inquiries.
Immigration permit fee standards, Article 3: ARC fees and specified reductions.
Employment Service Act, Articles 43 and 48: work authorization and exemptions.

Where the application goes

When does the deadline for my first ARC start?

For entry with a resident visa and residence permission, the 30-day period starts the day after arrival. If the resident visa is issued after you arrive, BOCA's guidance counts 30 days from its issuance. Visitors applying directly for residence must meet the eligibility and filing rules for their category.
How much does a first ARC cost?

The standard charge is NT$1,000 for each year of approved validity; a period under one year is charged as one year. Applications after visa-exempt or visitor-visa entry carry an additional NT$2,200 under the fee rules. Specified reductions and exemptions may apply.
Can I start work once I receive an ARC?
Only if the actual job and employer are covered by the permit or exemption that applies to you. An ARC records residence permission; it does not by itself establish unrestricted work rights.

Panduan kediaman NIA dan panduan BOCA menerangkan dua keadaan pertama. Orang yang masuk tanpa visa tidak dengan sendirinya mendapat tempoh 30 hari untuk menukar status kepada pemastautin.

Bagi profesional yang memenuhi syarat, perkara 16 Akta Pengambilan dan Penggajian Profesional Asing membenarkan permohonan kediaman terus kepada NIA selepas masuk tanpa visa atau dengan visa lawatan. Kebenaran bekerja atau pengecualian yang berkenaan tetap diperlukan, dan cara masuk mesti layak untuk laluan itu. Syarat bagi pelajar serta ahli keluarga dihuraikan dalam pilihan kediaman untuk bekerja, belajar dan menyertai keluarga.

Untuk permohonan berasaskan visa kediaman, senarai dokumen NIA meminta borang, gambar mengikut spesifikasi yang diambil dalam dua tahun terakhir, pasport dan visa kediaman, bukti tujuan kediaman serta alamat semasa. Dokumen asal dan salinan perlu disediakan seperti yang disenaraikan. Dokumen asal dipulangkan selepas diperiksa.
Surat yang diperlukan daripada majikan, sekolah atau keluarga bergantung pada asas permohonan:
Pekerjaan: kelulusan kerja yang berkenaan dan surat pengesahan pekerjaan yang dikeluarkan dalam tempoh sebulan sebelum permohonan, atau bukti kelayakan untuk pengecualian permit.

Pengajian formal: surat tawaran kemasukan sebelum pendaftaran; selepas mendaftar, bukti pengajian terkini, termasuk pengesahan yang dikeluarkan dalam tempoh sebulan dan rekod pendaftaran semester berkenaan.
Kediaman bersama keluarga: sijil perkahwinan atau kelahiran yang membuktikan hubungan, bersama dokumen pengenalan atau kediaman ahli keluarga yang menjadi penaja.

Perjanjian sewa boleh membuktikan alamat. Jika menumpang di rumah orang lain, panduan yang sama menyediakan pilihan dokumen seperti persetujuan pemilik bersama bukti pemilikan atau dokumen pengenalan pemilik yang berkenaan. Alamat untuk menerima surat sahaja belum membuktikan tempat tinggal sebenar.

Permohonan pertama sebagai pasangan warganegara Taiwan yang menetap di Taiwan dan mempunyai pendaftaran isi rumah (戶籍) memerlukan pasangan Taiwan hadir bersama. Bukti bahawa perkahwinan sudah didaftarkan di Taiwan juga diperlukan. Tempoh sah kad pertama bagi kategori ini ialah paling lama setahun, menurut perkara 12 peraturan kediaman. Panduan kediaman NIA menerangkan prosedur kehadiran pasangan dan dokumennya. Huraian lanjut tentang dokumen keluarga terdapat dalam artikel kediaman melalui pasangan Taiwan, dalam bahasa Inggeris.

Adakah semua pemohon perlu menyerahkan sijil rekod jenayah dan laporan pemeriksaan kesihatan? Keperluannya bergantung pada kategori visa atau kediaman serta cara masuk. Kedua-duanya bukan dokumen wajib bagi setiap permohonan kad pertama.

Dokumen luar negara pula tertakluk pada pengesahan. NIA memerlukan pengesahan dokumen yang dikeluarkan di luar negara dan boleh meminta terjemahan bahasa Cina yang disahkan atau diperakui mengikut kaedah yang ditetapkan. Pejabat perwakilan Taiwan yang bertanggungjawab bagi tempat dokumen dikeluarkan boleh menjelaskan prosedurnya.

Direktori permohonan kediaman NIA membezakan permohonan umum, profesional dan tanggungan mereka, pelajar serta pekerja migran. Setiap kategori mempunyai sistem dalam talian atau prosedur pusat perkhidmatannya sendiri. Portal profesional hanya sesuai jika kategori pekerjaan pemohon termasuk dalam skopnya.

Pelajar mengikuti prosedur dalam talian khusus. Permohonan biasa di kaunter dibuat di pusat perkhidmatan NIA yang meliputi alamat semasa; panduan kediaman NIA juga menetapkan saluran ini untuk permohonan melalui pasangan Taiwan. Jadual kehadiran pasangan perlu diambil kira bagi permohonan pertama.

Nombor permohonan, salinan dokumen yang dimuat naik dan notis daripada NIA perlu disimpan. Jika NIA meminta dokumen tambahan, notis itu menyatakan perkara yang masih perlu dilengkapkan serta tempoh untuk berbuat demikian. Penghantaran borang belum merupakan kelulusan.

Yuran mengikut tempoh yang diluluskan. Perkara 3 piawaian yuran dokumen imigresen menetapkan NT$1,000 setahun untuk ARC biasa; tempoh kurang daripada setahun dikira sebagai setahun. Permohonan selepas masuk tanpa visa atau dengan visa lawatan dikenakan tambahan NT$2,200. Pengurangan 50% untuk 僑生, iaitu pelajar Cina seberang laut dengan status berkenaan, tidak meliputi semua pelajar antarabangsa.

NIA menentukan tempoh sah berdasarkan kelayakan dan dokumen. Had biasa ialah tiga tahun di bawah perkara 22 Akta Imigresen. Kad pertama melalui pasangan Taiwan tertakluk pada had paling lama setahun yang diterangkan tadi.

Membayar yuran lebih tinggi tidak membolehkan pemohon memilih tempoh sesuka hati.

NIA menyatakan masa pemprosesan biasa selama sepuluh hari bekerja, tidak termasuk masa untuk pemulangan dokumen, penyerahan dokumen tambahan dan temu duga. Kiraan bermula semula selepas dokumen tambahan diserahkan. Prosedur dalam talian mempunyai jadual mengikut kategori; bagi pelajar, panduan menetapkan lima hari bekerja, dengan masa melengkapkan dokumen dikecualikan dan kiraan bermula semula selepas dokumen dilengkapkan.

Di bawah prosedur pelajar, bayaran mesti dibuat dalam masa lima hari bekerja dari kelulusan. Pemohon kad ARC bercip perlu mencetak resit bayaran dalam talian dan mengambil kad di pusat NIA yang dipilih, tiga hari bekerja selepas bayaran selesai. ARC elektronik dengan tempoh sah enam bulan atau kurang boleh dimuat turun dan dicetak selepas pembayaran. Jadual ini khusus untuk prosedur pelajar. Pemohon lain mengikuti kaedah serta dokumen pengenalan yang dinyatakan dalam notis kelulusan atau pengambilan mereka.

Semasa menerima kad, nama, butiran pasport, alamat dan tarikh tamat kediaman perlu dipadankan dengan keputusan serta dokumen permohonan. Kesilapan boleh dimaklumkan kepada unit yang mengendalikan permohonan.

Selepas kad diterima, lanjutan, perubahan maklumat dan kemasukan semula mempunyai urusannya sendiri. Piawaian yuran dokumen imigresen, perkara 3: yuran dan pengurangan tertentu.
Akta Perkhidmatan Pekerjaan, perkara 43 dan 48: permit kerja dan pengecualian.

Bukti tujuan kediaman dan alamat sebenar

Yuran, tempoh sah dan pengambilan kad
Sumber rasmi
Bilakah tempoh memohon ARC pertama mula dikira?

Jika anda masuk dengan visa kediaman dan mendapat kebenaran menetap, tempoh 30 hari bermula pada hari selepas ketibaan. Jika visa kediaman dikeluarkan selepas anda berada di Taiwan, BOCA mengira 30 hari dari tarikh visa itu dikeluarkan. reviews.sourceMarkdown:
Thirty days is the filing period for your first Alien Resident Certificate (ARC) if you enter Taiwan on a resident visa and receive residence permission. Count from the day after arrival. [Immigration Act Article 22](https://law.moj.gov.tw/LawClass/LawSingle.aspx?pcode=D0080132&flno=22) requires the application to the National Immigration Agency (NIA), which issues the card as evidence of approved residence.

Visitors have a different starting point: they must qualify for a permitted change to residence before they can apply. Holding a valid combined document with ARC functions, such as an Employment Gold Card, removes the need for a separate card under the exception in [Article 22](https://law.moj.gov.tw/LawClass/LawSingle.aspx?pcode=D0080132&flno=22).

## Which date starts the application period?

Your visa and entry record determine the deadline. Someone who receives a resident visa while already in Taiwan uses a different starting date from someone who arrives with one.

| Entry and visa status | When to apply |
|---|---|
| Entered with a resident visa | Within 30 days counted from the day after entry. |
| Received a resident visa after arriving in Taiwan | Within 30 days from the resident visa's issuance date, under BOCA's guidance. |
| Entered visa-exempt or with a visitor visa | Before the permitted stay expires, subject to the eligibility and filing rules for the residence category. |

[NIA's residence guide](https://www.immigration.gov.tw/5475/5478/141465/141808/141970) and [BOCA's resident-visa guidance](https://www.boca.gov.tw/cp-166-276-48430-2.html) explain the first two situations. For eligible professionals, [Article 16 of the Act for the Recruitment and Employment of Foreign Professionals](https://law.moj.gov.tw/ENG/LawClass/LawAll.aspx?pcode=A0030295) permits a direct NIA residence application after visitor-visa or visa-exempt entry, with work authorization or an applicable exemption. Eligibility is specific to that route; the [work, study and family comparison](/en/columns/taiwan-visa-residence-work-study-family) explains the conditions for other applicants.

## Documents that establish your residence basis

An application based on a resident visa needs the form, photograph, passport and resident visa, evidence of the reason for residence, and proof of your current address, according to [NIA's checklist](https://www.immigration.gov.tw/5475/5478/141465/141808/141970). Bring the required originals and copies. A lease is one accepted address document.

The supporting evidence depends on why you are staying:

- Employment: the relevant work approval and a certificate of employment issued within the preceding month, or evidence of the applicable exemption.
- Degree study: an admission letter before registration, or recent enrollment evidence once registered.
- Family residence: marriage or birth records proving the relationship, together with the sponsoring family member's identity or residence documents.

For a first application through marriage to a Taiwan national with household registration, the Taiwan spouse must attend. NIA also requires proof that the marriage is registered in Taiwan and gives the first spouse-based card one-year validity. These requirements appear in the [NIA guide](https://www.immigration.gov.tw/5475/5478/141465/141808/141970); the [Taiwan-spouse residence article](/en/columns/taiwan-foreign-spouse-residence) covers the family documents in more detail.

Certificates issued abroad may take longer to prepare than the application form. NIA requires authentication of overseas documents and may ask for a Chinese translation verified or notarized in the prescribed manner. The [Taiwan overseas mission responsible for the place of issue](https://www.boca.gov.tw/sp-foof-countrylp-01-2.html) can explain the authentication procedure. Police certificates and health examinations depend on the particular visa or residence category; they are not required in every first-card application.

## Where the application goes

NIA's [residence application directory](https://www.immigration.gov.tw/5382/5385/7244/7250/7317/%E5%B1%85%E7%95%99/) separates general residence applications from those for professionals and their dependents, students, and migrant workers. Each category has a designated online system or service-center procedure. Using the professional-worker system is appropriate only if your employment category belongs there.

Students use a [dedicated online procedure](https://www.immigration.gov.tw/5475/5478/141465/141808/417829/cp_news). For the ordinary in-person application, the relevant NIA service center is the one covering your current address; NIA specifically directs Taiwan-spouse applications there in its [residence guide](https://www.immigration.gov.tw/5475/5478/141465/141808/141970).

Keep the submission record and uploaded documents. If NIA requests further evidence, retaining the request with the original file makes it clear which documents still need to be supplied.

## Fees, processing and collection

Standard ARC fees are NT$1,000 for each year of approved validity, with a period under one year charged as a full year. [Article 3 of the immigration permit fee standards](https://law.moj.gov.tw/LawClass/LawAll.aspx?pcode=D0080135) adds NT$2,200 for applications following visa-exempt or visitor-visa entry. Its reduction for overseas compatriot students applies to that status, not to international students generally.

NIA decides the approved term. The ordinary statutory maximum is three years, while qualifying specialist professionals have a separate maximum under their legislation ([Immigration Act Article 22](https://law.moj.gov.tw/LawClass/LawSingle.aspx?pcode=D0080132&flno=22); [Foreign Professionals Act Article 8](https://law.moj.gov.tw/ENG/LawClass/LawAll.aspx?pcode=A0030295)). Paying a higher fee cannot establish eligibility for a longer period.

For general applications, [NIA gives a processing time of ten working days](https://www.immigration.gov.tw/5475/5478/141465/141808/141970), excluding document return, requests for additional documents and interviews. The processing period starts again after the additional documents are submitted. Online categories have their own schedules, which may affect travel plans while the application is pending.

Under the [student online procedure](https://www.immigration.gov.tw/5475/5478/141465/141808/417829/cp_news), payment is due within five working days from approval. A student collecting a smart-chip ARC must print the online payment receipt and take it to the selected NIA service center three working days after payment. That timetable applies to this student procedure; other applicants should follow the method and identification requirements in their approval or collection notice.

Check the issued card against your application. The name, passport details, address and residence expiry date should match the approved particulars; keep the receipt and decision with your immigration records.

An ARC alone does not authorize every job. Before starting work, the relevant permit or exemption must cover the actual employment under [Employment Service Act Articles 43 and 48](https://law.moj.gov.tw/ENG/LawClass/LawAll.aspx?pcode=N0090001). Once you have the card, its expiry date and any later changes to your address or employment determine the next filings; travel may also require attention to re-entry permission. Those situations are covered in the [renewal and changes guide](/en/columns/taiwan-arc-renewal-changes-reentry).

Sources checked October 24, 2026. This procedural guide concerns foreign nationals and does not determine individual eligibility. Mainland China residents, Hong Kong and Macau residents, and ROC nationals without household registration follow separate frameworks.

## Official sources

- [Immigration Act, Article 22](https://law.moj.gov.tw/LawClass/LawSingle.aspx?pcode=D0080132&flno=22): first-card deadline, integrated-document exception and ordinary validity limit.
- [NIA, residence, extension and change applications](https://www.immigration.gov.tw/5475/5478/141465/141808/141970), updated April 14, 2026: documents, fees, processing and spouse attendance.
- [BOCA, resident visas for professional employees](https://www.boca.gov.tw/cp-166-276-48430-2.html): ARC timing following resident visa issuance in Taiwan.
- [Act for the Recruitment and Employment of Foreign Professionals](https://law.moj.gov.tw/ENG/LawClass/LawAll.aspx?pcode=A0030295), Articles 8 and 16: specialist validity and direct residence applications.
- [NIA, residence application directory](https://www.immigration.gov.tw/5382/5385/7244/7250/7317/%E5%B1%85%E7%95%99/): category-specific application channels.
- [NIA, student online applications](https://www.immigration.gov.tw/5475/5478/141465/141808/417829/cp_news), updated August 28, 2026: student filing, payment and collection.
- [Taiwan overseas mission directory](https://www.boca.gov.tw/sp-foof-countrylp-01-2.html): document authentication inquiries.
- [Immigration permit fee standards](https://law.moj.gov.tw/LawClass/LawAll.aspx?pcode=D0080135), Article 3: ARC fees and specified reductions.
- [Employment Service Act](https://law.moj.gov.tw/ENG/LawClass/LawAll.aspx?pcode=N0090001), Articles 43 and 48: work authorization and exemptions.

NIA memerlukan pengesahan dokumen yang dikeluarkan di luar negara dan boleh meminta terjemahan bahasa Cina yang disahkan atau diperakui mengikut kaedah yang ditetapkan. [Pejabat perwakilan Taiwan yang bertanggungjawab bagi tempat dokumen dikeluarkan](https://www.boca.gov.tw/sp-foof-countrylp-01-2.html) boleh menjelaskan prosedurnya.

## Saluran permohonan dan keputusan NIA

[Direktori permohonan kediaman NIA](https://www.immigration.gov.tw/5382/5385/7244/7250/7317/%E5%B1%85%E7%95%99/) membezakan permohonan umum, profesional dan tanggungan mereka, pelajar serta pekerja migran. Setiap kategori mempunyai sistem dalam talian atau prosedur pusat perkhidmatannya sendiri. Portal profesional hanya sesuai jika kategori pekerjaan pemohon termasuk dalam skopnya.

Pelajar mengikuti [prosedur dalam talian khusus](https://www.immigration.gov.tw/5475/5478/141465/141808/417829/cp_news). Permohonan biasa di kaunter dibuat di pusat perkhidmatan NIA yang meliputi alamat semasa; panduan kediaman NIA juga menetapkan saluran ini untuk permohonan melalui pasangan Taiwan. Jadual kehadiran pasangan perlu diambil kira bagi permohonan pertama.

Nombor permohonan, salinan dokumen yang dimuat naik dan notis daripada NIA perlu disimpan. Jika NIA meminta dokumen tambahan, notis itu menyatakan perkara yang masih perlu dilengkapkan serta tempoh untuk berbuat demikian. Penghantaran borang belum merupakan kelulusan.

## Yuran, tempoh sah dan pengambilan kad

Yuran mengikut tempoh yang diluluskan. [Perkara 3 piawaian yuran dokumen imigresen](https://law.moj.gov.tw/LawClass/LawAll.aspx?pcode=D0080135) menetapkan NT$1,000 setahun untuk ARC biasa; tempoh kurang daripada setahun dikira sebagai setahun. Permohonan selepas masuk tanpa visa atau dengan visa lawatan dikenakan tambahan NT$2,200. Pengurangan 50% untuk 僑生, iaitu pelajar Cina seberang laut dengan status berkenaan, tidak meliputi semua pelajar antarabangsa.

NIA menentukan tempoh sah berdasarkan kelayakan dan dokumen. Had biasa ialah tiga tahun di bawah [perkara 22 Akta Imigresen](https://law.moj.gov.tw/LawClass/LawSingle.aspx?pcode=D0080132&flno=22). Kad pertama melalui pasangan Taiwan tertakluk pada had paling lama setahun yang diterangkan tadi.

Bagi profesional asing berkepakaran khusus yang diambil bekerja dan mendapat kebenaran kediaman, [perkara 8 Akta Pengambilan dan Penggajian Profesional Asing](https://law.moj.gov.tw/ENG/LawClass/LawAll.aspx?pcode=A0030295) menetapkan had lima tahun, dikira mulai hari selepas kelulusan. Aturan tempoh itu turut meliputi ahli keluarga yang disenaraikan dalam perkara tersebut apabila kediaman mereka diluluskan. Kad Emas pula mempunyai tempoh satu hingga tiga tahun di bawah perkara 9. Membayar yuran lebih tinggi tidak membolehkan pemohon memilih tempoh sesuka hati.

[NIA menyatakan masa pemprosesan biasa selama sepuluh hari bekerja](https://www.immigration.gov.tw/5475/5478/141465/141808/141970), tidak termasuk masa untuk pemulangan dokumen, penyerahan dokumen tambahan dan temu duga. Kiraan bermula semula selepas dokumen tambahan diserahkan. Prosedur dalam talian mempunyai jadual mengikut kategori; bagi pelajar, panduan menetapkan lima hari bekerja, dengan masa melengkapkan dokumen dikecualikan dan kiraan bermula semula selepas dokumen dilengkapkan.

Di bawah [prosedur pelajar](https://www.immigration.gov.tw/5475/5478/141465/141808/417829/cp_news), bayaran mesti dibuat dalam masa lima hari bekerja dari kelulusan. Pemohon kad ARC bercip perlu mencetak resit bayaran dalam talian dan mengambil kad di pusat NIA yang dipilih, tiga hari bekerja selepas bayaran selesai. ARC elektronik dengan tempoh sah enam bulan atau kurang boleh dimuat turun dan dicetak selepas pembayaran. Jadual ini khusus untuk prosedur pelajar. Pemohon lain mengikuti kaedah serta dokumen pengenalan yang dinyatakan dalam notis kelulusan atau pengambilan mereka.

Semasa menerima kad, nama, butiran pasport, alamat dan tarikh tamat kediaman perlu dipadankan dengan keputusan serta dokumen permohonan. Kesilapan boleh dimaklumkan kepada unit yang mengendalikan permohonan.

Sebelum bekerja, pekerjaan sebenar mesti diliputi permit atau pengecualian di bawah [perkara 43 dan 48 Akta Perkhidmatan Pekerjaan](https://law.moj.gov.tw/ENG/LawClass/LawAll.aspx?pcode=N0090001). Selepas kad diterima, [lanjutan, perubahan maklumat dan kemasukan semula](/ms/columns/taiwan-arc-renewal-changes-reentry) mempunyai urusannya sendiri. Tarikh luput pada kad serta tarikh perpindahan rumah atau perubahan pekerjaan akan menentukan permohonan seterusnya.

Asas undang-undang dan panduan pentadbiran disemak pada 24 Oktober 2026. Artikel ini menerangkan prosedur umum bagi warga asing, tanpa menentukan kelayakan individu. Penduduk tanah besar China, Hong Kong dan Macau serta warganegara Republik China tanpa pendaftaran isi rumah di Taiwan tertakluk pada sistem berasingan.

sourceEvidence.text: For entry with a resident visa and residence permission, the 30-day period starts the day after arrival. If the resident visa is issued after you arrive, BOCA's guidance counts 30 days from its issuance. Visitors applying directly for residence must meet the eligibility and filing rules for their category.

The standard charge is NT$1,000 for each year of approved validity; a period under one year is charged as one year. Applications after visa-exempt or visitor-visa entry carry an additional NT$2,200 under the fee rules. Specified reductions and exemptions may apply.

Thirty days is the filing period for your first Alien Resident Certificate (ARC) if you enter Taiwan on a resident visa and receive residence permission. Count from the day after arrival. Immigration Act Article 22 requires the application to the National Immigration Agency (NIA), which issues the card as evidence of approved residence.

Visitors have a different starting point: they must qualify for a permitted change to residence before they can apply. Holding a valid combined document with ARC functions, such as an Employment Gold Card, removes the need for a separate card under the exception in Article 22.
Within 30 days counted from the day after entry.
Within 30 days from the resident visa's issuance date, under BOCA's guidance.

NIA's residence guide and BOCA's resident-visa guidance explain the first two situations. For eligible professionals, Article 16 of the Act for the Recruitment and Employment of Foreign Professionals permits a direct NIA residence application after visitor-visa or visa-exempt entry, with work authorization or an applicable exemption. Eligibility is specific to that route; the work, study and family comparison explains the conditions for other applicants.

Standard ARC fees are NT$1,000 for each year of approved validity, with a period under one year charged as a full year. Article 3 of the immigration permit fee standards adds NT$2,200 for applications following visa-exempt or visitor-visa entry. Its reduction for overseas compatriot students applies to that status, not to international students generally.

NIA decides the approved term. The ordinary statutory maximum is three years, while qualifying specialist professionals have a separate maximum under their legislation (Immigration Act Article 22; Foreign Professionals Act Article 8). Paying a higher fee cannot establish eligibility for a longer period.

An ARC alone does not authorize every job. Before starting work, the relevant permit or exemption must cover the actual employment under Employment Service Act Articles 43 and 48. Once you have the card, its expiry date and any later changes to your address or employment determine the next filings; travel may also require attention to re-entry permission. Those situations are covered in the renewal and changes guide.

sourceHints.text: Thirty days is the filing period for your first Alien Resident Certificate (ARC) if you enter Taiwan on a resident visa and receive residence permission. Count from the day after arrival. Immigration Act Article 22 requires the application to the National Immigration Agency (NIA), which issues the card as evidence of approved residence.
Your visa and entry record determine the deadline. Someone who receives a resident visa while already in Taiwan uses a different starting date from someone who arrives with one.
Received a resident visa after arriving in Taiwan

An application based on a resident visa needs the form, photograph, passport and resident visa, evidence of the reason for residence, and proof of your current address, according to NIA's checklist. Bring the required originals and copies. A lease is one accepted address document.

For a first application through marriage to a Taiwan national with household registration, the Taiwan spouse must attend. NIA also requires proof that the marriage is registered in Taiwan and gives the first spouse-based card one-year validity. These requirements appear in the NIA guide; the Taiwan-spouse residence article covers the family documents in more detail.

Certificates issued abroad may take longer to prepare than the application form. NIA requires authentication of overseas documents and may ask for a Chinese translation verified or notarized in the prescribed manner. The Taiwan overseas mission responsible for the place of issue can explain the authentication procedure. Police certificates and health examinations depend on the particular visa or residence category; they are not required in every first-card application.

Students use a dedicated online procedure. For the ordinary in-person application, the relevant NIA service center is the one covering your current address; NIA specifically directs Taiwan-spouse applications there in its residence guide.

Check the issued card against your application. The name, passport details, address and residence expiry date should match the approved particulars; keep the receipt and decision with your immigration records.

targetFields.text: Menetap di Taiwan untuk bekerja, belajar atau menyertai keluarga
Visa Taiwan untuk kerja, pengajian dan keluarga
Kelayakan menetap di Taiwan bergantung pada tujuan, status penaja dan cara masuk. Visa untuk pengajian, pekerjaan serta keluarga mempunyai syarat berbeza.
Komputer riba yang ditutup, buku dan dua cawan bersebelahan buku dokumen perjalanan tanpa tanda
Adegan rekaan
Bolehkah saya memohon kediaman selepas masuk ke Taiwan tanpa visa?

Perkara 16 Akta Pengambilan dan Penggajian Profesional Asing membenarkan profesional yang memenuhi syarat permit atau pengecualian, serta ahli keluarga tertentu, memohon terus kepada NIA. Cara masuk yang digunakan juga mesti layak. Laluan biasa bagi pengajian formal dan pembelajaran bahasa Mandarin mempunyai syarat kemasukan yang lain.
Berapa lama perlu belajar bahasa Mandarin sebelum memohon ARC?

Laluan kediaman ini memerlukan visa lawatan untuk tujuan belajar bahasa Mandarin, empat bulan pengajian yang sudah diselesaikan di pusat bahasa bersekutu dengan universiti yang diiktiraf, serta pendaftaran untuk sekurang-kurangnya tiga bulan lagi. Syarat jam kelas, kehadiran dan dokumen sokongan juga perlu dipenuhi. Pendaftaran sahaja tidak mencukupi.
Adakah setiap pemegang ARC boleh menaja pasangannya untuk menetap?

Tidak. Kewarganegaraan dan kategori kediaman penaja, hubungan keluarga serta status kemasukan pemohon menentukan kelayakan. Peraturan keluarga profesional asing berbeza daripada peraturan pasangan warganegara Taiwan. Undang-undang juga mengecualikan sesetengah kategori penaja daripada laluan tertentu.

sourcePassages.text: Visa-exempt entry may suit a qualifying professional who intends to apply for residence in Taiwan, but it can rule out the ordinary in-country application for a degree or Mandarin student. Foreign Professionals Act Article 16 permits the professional route; BOCA's degree-study and Mandarin-study guidance set different entry conditions for students.
Nationality and the passport used determine visa eligibility. The Taiwan overseas mission handling your application provides the nationality-specific requirements and document procedures.

A temporary visitor's permitted activities and length of stay depend on the entry arrangement granted. A longer move requires a residence basis, such as employment, study or joining family. BOCA's resident-visa guidance covers those purposes, while the National Immigration Agency (NIA) decides residence applications and issues the Alien Resident Certificate (ARC).
Some eligible visitors can apply directly to NIA. Other applicants need the appropriate visa before entry, so arriving as a visitor leaves no general right to convert a short stay into residence.

For most foreign professional hires, the employer applies for a work permit, subject to statutory exceptions and the authority responsible for the job. Articles 4 and 5 of the Act for the Recruitment and Employment of Foreign Professionals define professional work and the permit framework. A signed offer is not work authorization.

Once a qualifying foreign professional or foreign specialist professional has the permit or an applicable exemption, Article 16 allows a direct residence application following visa-exempt or visitor-visa entry. NIA must still approve the residence application before issuing an ARC. The current Article 16 took effect on January 1, 2026, as recorded in the Act's legislative history.

NIA's guide excludes trial visa exemptions, the Southeast Asian online travel-authorization scheme and other listed entry arrangements from this direct-application route unless another rule applies, even where the applicant holds work approval.

Care work, fishing and other migrant-worker categories under Employment Service Act Article 46 have their own rules. NIA's migrant-worker residence procedure applies to those categories; employment in Taiwan does not by itself place a worker within the foreign-professional scheme. The category on the work approval identifies which procedure to use.

Full-time foreign students applying from abroad can seek a resident visa at a Taiwan overseas mission. Those who enter on a visitor visa specifically for foreign-student study may apply directly to NIA for residence. The ordinary in-country study route in BOCA's student guidance excludes visa-exempt entry, landing visas and visitor visas issued for other purposes.

Depending on the application, BOCA also requires educational records, financial evidence and a health certificate alongside the admission letter; the program's checklist determines which overseas records need authentication.

For Mandarin learners, the language-study visitor visa ordinarily comes before arrival. Eligibility for residence follows four completed months at a qualifying university-affiliated center, with registration for at least three more months. BOCA's Mandarin residence guidance requires at least 15 classroom hours a week, Monday through Friday. Absences, including leave, may not exceed one quarter of class hours. Tuition payment alone does not establish eligibility.

Can a student take a part-time job? Employment Service Act Articles 43 and 50 govern work permits and specified student employment. The admission letter and student ARC do not replace the work authorization needed for the job.

Family residence depends on the sponsor's status and the relationship. For a spouse of a Taiwan national residing in Taiwan with household registration, one in-country route under Immigration Act Article 23 requires a valid visa allowing a stay of at least 60 days and without the specified restrictions. Marriage therefore does not establish a general right to convert visa-exempt entry to residence. The required relationship documents and related status issues appear in residence through a Taiwan spouse.

When a foreign professional engaged in professional work in Taiwan or a foreign specialist professional already has approved residence or permanent residence, Article 16 allows certain family members to apply directly after visa-exempt or visitor-visa entry. It covers a spouse, minor children, and adult children unable to care for themselves because of physical or mental disability. Parents and other adult children are excluded.

Work rights vary by family category. Employment Service Act Article 48 provides a work-permit exemption for an approved resident married to a Taiwan national with household registration. Dependent spouses of foreign professionals cannot assume that exemption applies to them. For qualifying spouses of specialist or senior professionals, Foreign Professionals Act Article 15 provides a direct application for a work permit.

Specialist professionals who meet the program's criteria may qualify for an Employment Gold Card, which combines work, residence, visa and re-entry functions in one document. The Gold Card article covers that application separately.
BOCA publishes the entrepreneur route requirements for applicants planning to establish a business in Taiwan.

Working-holiday access depends on the nationality-specific program. The digital-nomad visitor visa has separate nationality and qualification requirements and does not automatically lead to an ARC. Foreign Professionals Act Article 14 limits that remote-work route to qualifying work without providing services to Taiwan businesses or employers.

Once the residence category and entry requirements are established, the first ARC application guide covers filing and collection. An existing resident moving to a new job, course or family basis also needs the rules on renewal and changes: the current card does not settle whether that new purpose qualifies.

Sources checked October 24, 2026. Eligibility still depends on the individual application. These routes concern foreign nationals; Mainland China residents, Hong Kong and Macau residents, and ROC nationals without household registration follow separate frameworks.

Eligibility also depends on the entry arrangement used. Ordinary degree-study and Mandarin-study routes have different entry requirements.
How long must I study Mandarin before applying for an ARC?

The residence route requires the appropriate study visitor visa, four completed months at a qualifying university-affiliated language center, and registration for at least three further months. Classroom hours, attendance and the required supporting documents also form part of the application conditions. Enrollment alone is insufficient.
Can every ARC holder sponsor a spouse for residence?

No. The sponsor's nationality and residence category, the relationship and the applicant's entry status all affect eligibility. The rules for a foreign professional's family differ from those for a spouse of a Taiwan national, and statutory exclusions apply to some sponsors.

targetPassages.text: Tujuan belajar bahasa Mandarin perlu sesuai dengan visa yang digunakan ketika masuk ke Taiwan jika anda bercadang memohon kediaman melalui pengajian itu. Menurut panduan BOCA tentang visa bahasa Mandarin, kemasukan tanpa visa, visa semasa ketibaan atau visa lawatan untuk tujuan lain tidak membolehkan pertukaran melalui laluan biasa tersebut. Surat tawaran daripada pusat bahasa tidak mengubah syarat kemasukan.

Profesional yang memenuhi syarat mempunyai pilihan lain. Perkara 16 Akta Pengambilan dan Penggajian Profesional Asing menyediakan permohonan kediaman terus selepas masuk tanpa visa atau dengan visa lawatan, tertakluk pada kelayakan kerja dan cara masuk. Kewarganegaraan serta pasport yang digunakan menentukan kelayakan visa; pejabat perwakilan Taiwan yang mengendalikan permohonan memberikan syarat dan prosedur dokumen yang berkenaan.

Tempoh serta aktiviti yang dibenarkan bagi lawatan singkat mengikut kebenaran masuk yang diberikan. Untuk menetap lebih lama, pemohon memerlukan asas seperti pekerjaan, pengajian atau hubungan keluarga. Panduan visa kediaman BOCA menerangkan tujuan-tujuan ini. Agensi Imigresen Kebangsaan (NIA) pula memutuskan permohonan kediaman dan mengeluarkan kad kediaman warga asing, atau ARC.

Sebahagian pemohon yang layak boleh terus memohon kepada NIA ketika berada di Taiwan. Sesetengah permohonan pula memerlukan visa yang sesuai sebelum ketibaan. Tiada hak umum untuk menukar setiap lawatan singkat kepada kediaman.

Majikan biasanya memohon permit bagi pengambilan profesional asing, tertakluk pada pengecualian undang-undang dan pihak berkuasa yang bertanggungjawab terhadap pekerjaan itu. Perkara 4 dan 5 Akta Pengambilan dan Penggajian Profesional Asing mentakrifkan kerja profesional serta mengatur permitnya. Surat tawaran kerja belum memberikan kebenaran bekerja.

Profesional asing atau profesional asing berkepakaran khusus yang menjalankan kerja profesional di Taiwan dengan permit atau pengecualian yang berkenaan boleh memohon kediaman terus di bawah perkara 16 selepas masuk tanpa visa atau dengan visa lawatan. ARC dikeluarkan setelah NIA meluluskan kediaman. Perkara 16 semasa berkuat kuasa pada 1 Januari 2026, seperti direkodkan dalam sejarah perundangan akta itu.

Namun, skim kemasukan tertentu dikecualikan daripada laluan dalam panduan NIA, kecuali peraturan lain memperuntukkan sebaliknya. Antaranya ialah pengecualian visa percubaan, visa semasa ketibaan, kebenaran perjalanan dalam talian untuk warga negara Asia Tenggara (TAC), Kad Perjalanan Perniagaan APEC dan skim percutian sambil bekerja. Memiliki kelulusan kerja sahaja tidak mengetepikan sekatan ini. Catatan sekatan pada visa juga perlu diambil kira.

Pekerja penjagaan, perikanan dan kategori pekerja migran lain di bawah perkara 46 Akta Perkhidmatan Pekerjaan mempunyai aturan tersendiri. Mereka mengikuti prosedur kediaman pekerja migran NIA. Kategori yang tercatat pada kelulusan kerja menentukan prosedur; pekerjaan di Taiwan tidak dengan sendirinya menjadikan seseorang profesional asing di bawah akta tersebut.

Pelajar asing sepenuh masa yang memohon dari luar Taiwan boleh mendapatkan visa kediaman melalui pejabat perwakilan Taiwan. Mereka yang sudah masuk dengan visa lawatan khusus untuk pengajian pelajar asing boleh memohon kediaman terus kepada NIA apabila memenuhi syarat. Panduan pelajar BOCA mengecualikan kemasukan tanpa visa, visa semasa ketibaan dan visa lawatan untuk tujuan lain daripada laluan pertukaran biasa di Taiwan.

Selain surat tawaran kemasukan, BOCA meminta rekod pendidikan, bukti kewangan dan sijil kesihatan mengikut permohonan. Senarai dokumen program berkenaan menentukan rekod luar negara yang memerlukan pengesahan. Kelulusan kemasukan sekolah dan kelulusan kediaman dibuat secara berasingan.

Bagi pembelajaran bahasa Mandarin, visa lawatan untuk tujuan tersebut lazimnya diperoleh sebelum tiba. Panduan kediaman BOCA mensyaratkan empat bulan pengajian yang telah diselesaikan di pusat bahasa bersekutu dengan universiti yang diiktiraf, serta pendaftaran untuk sekurang-kurangnya tiga bulan lagi. Kelas mesti berjumlah sekurang-kurangnya 15 jam seminggu, dari Isnin hingga Jumaat. Ketidakhadiran, termasuk cuti, tidak boleh melebihi satu perempat jumlah jam kelas. Rekod pendaftaran dan kehadiran membuktikan syarat ini; pembayaran yuran pengajian sahaja tidak mencukupi.

Bolehkah pelajar mengambil kerja sambilan? Perkara 43 dan 50 Akta Perkhidmatan Pekerjaan mengatur permit dan pekerjaan pelajar yang diliputinya. Surat tawaran serta ARC pelajar tidak menggantikan kebenaran kerja yang diperlukan. Artikel permit kerja sambilan pelajar menerangkan perbezaan status pelajar dan had jam dengan lebih terperinci.

Status ahli keluarga di Taiwan menentukan dokumen dan laluan kediaman. Bagi pasangan warganegara Taiwan yang menetap di Taiwan serta mempunyai pendaftaran isi rumah, salah satu laluan permohonan di Taiwan di bawah perkara 23 Akta Imigresen memerlukan visa sah yang membenarkan sekurang-kurangnya 60 hari tinggal, tanpa catatan larangan lanjutan atau sekatan lain yang dinyatakan. Sijil perkahwinan sahaja tidak memberikan hak umum untuk menukar kemasukan tanpa visa kepada kediaman. Dokumen hubungan dan isu status dihuraikan dalam kediaman melalui pasangan Taiwan, dalam bahasa Inggeris.

Keluarga profesional asing mempunyai peruntukan khusus. Apabila profesional asing yang menjalankan kerja profesional di Taiwan, atau profesional asing berkepakaran khusus, telah mendapat kebenaran kediaman atau kediaman tetap, perkara 16 membolehkan ahli keluarga berikut memohon terus selepas masuk tanpa visa atau dengan visa lawatan: pasangan, anak bawah umur dan anak dewasa yang tidak mampu mengurus diri akibat ketidakupayaan fizikal atau mental. Ibu bapa tidak termasuk. Anak dewasa yang lain juga di luar skop ini. Sekatan cara masuk dan pengecualian di bawah aturan berkenaan tetap perlu diperiksa; kategori keluarga pemastautin asing yang lain tertakluk pada peraturannya sendiri.

Kebenaran bekerja selepas mendapat kediaman keluarga juga berbeza. Perkara 48 Akta Perkhidmatan Pekerjaan memberikan pengecualian permit kepada warga asing yang mendapat kebenaran menetap dan berkahwin dengan warganegara Taiwan yang mempunyai pendaftaran isi rumah. Pengecualian itu tidak secara automatik terpakai kepada pasangan profesional asing. Pasangan profesional asing berkepakaran khusus atau profesional kanan asing yang memenuhi syarat boleh memohon permit kerja sendiri di bawah perkara 15 Akta Pengambilan dan Penggajian Profesional Asing.

Kad Emas Pekerjaan menggabungkan permit kerja, visa kediaman, ARC dan permit masuk semula. Pemohon mesti memenuhi syarat kepakaran bidang yang ditetapkan. Butirannya terdapat dalam artikel Kad Emas, dalam bahasa Inggeris.
Untuk rancangan menubuhkan perniagaan, BOCA menyediakan syarat laluan usahawan. Laluan itu mempunyai kriteria dan dokumen tersendiri.

Penyertaan dalam percutian sambil bekerja mengikut program untuk kewarganegaraan berkenaan. Visa lawatan nomad digital pula mempunyai syarat kewarganegaraan serta kelayakan tersendiri dan tidak secara automatik membawa kepada ARC. Perkara 14 Akta Pengambilan dan Penggajian Profesional Asing mengehadkan laluan kerja jarak jauh itu kepada kegiatan yang layak, tanpa memberikan perkhidmatan kepada perniagaan atau majikan di Taiwan.

Setelah kategori kediaman serta cara masuk dikenal pasti, permohonan ARC pertama meliputi penghantaran dokumen dan pengambilan kad. Pemegang ARC yang beralih kepada pekerjaan, kursus atau asas keluarga baharu pula perlu mengurus lanjutan dan perubahan kediaman. Dokumen sokongan menunjukkan kategori yang boleh dipohon. Cara masuk pula menentukan sama ada permohonan itu boleh diteruskan selepas ketibaan.

Asas undang-undang dan panduan pentadbiran disemak pada 24 Oktober 2026. Kelayakan bergantung pada permohonan individu. Laluan ini berkenaan warga asing; penduduk tanah besar China, Hong Kong dan Macau serta warganegara Republik China tanpa pendaftaran isi rumah di Taiwan tertakluk pada sistem berasingan.
Akta Pengambilan dan Penggajian Profesional Asing, perkara 4, 5, 14, 15 dan 16; sejarah perundangan dan tarikh kuat kuasa.
Akta Imigresen Taiwan, perkara 23: laluan kediaman yang layak dipohon dari Taiwan.
Akta Perkhidmatan Pekerjaan, perkara 43, 46, 48 dan 50: kategori kerja, permit, pengecualian dan pekerjaan pelajar.
BOCA: visa kediaman, pelajar asing, visa lawatan untuk bahasa Mandarin dan kediaman untuk bahasa Mandarin.
NIA, permohonan kediaman selepas masuk dengan visa lawatan atau tanpa visa, nota 7(1), dikemas kini pada 14 April 2026: cara masuk yang dikecualikan dan pengecualian di bawah peraturan lain.
NIA, permohonan kediaman pekerja migran.
Maklumat rasmi Kad Emas Pekerjaan dan bahan BOCA untuk usahawan.
BOCA: program percutian sambil bekerja dan visa lawatan nomad digital.
Direktori pejabat perwakilan Taiwan di luar negara: pejabat konsular yang berkenaan.

Bolehkah saya memohon kediaman selepas masuk ke Taiwan tanpa visa?

Perkara 16 Akta Pengambilan dan Penggajian Profesional Asing membenarkan profesional yang memenuhi syarat permit atau pengecualian, serta ahli keluarga tertentu, memohon terus kepada NIA. Cara masuk yang digunakan juga mesti layak. Laluan biasa bagi pengajian formal dan pembelajaran bahasa Mandarin mempunyai syarat kemasukan yang lain.
Berapa lama perlu belajar bahasa Mandarin sebelum memohon ARC?

Laluan kediaman ini memerlukan visa lawatan untuk tujuan belajar bahasa Mandarin, empat bulan pengajian yang sudah diselesaikan di pusat bahasa bersekutu dengan universiti yang diiktiraf, serta pendaftaran untuk sekurang-kurangnya tiga bulan lagi. Syarat jam kelas, kehadiran dan dokumen sokongan juga perlu dipenuhi. Pendaftaran sahaja tidak mencukupi.
Adakah setiap pemegang ARC boleh menaja pasangannya untuk menetap?

Tidak. Kewarganegaraan dan kategori kediaman penaja, hubungan keluarga serta status kemasukan pemohon menentukan kelayakan. Peraturan keluarga profesional asing berbeza daripada peraturan pasangan warganegara Taiwan. Undang-undang juga mengecualikan sesetengah kategori penaja daripada laluan tertentu.

Visa-exempt entry may suit a qualifying professional who intends to apply for residence in Taiwan, but it can rule out the ordinary in-country application for a degree or Mandarin student. [Foreign Professionals Act Article 16](https://law.moj.gov.tw/ENG/LawClass/LawAll.aspx?pcode=A0030295) permits the professional route; BOCA's [degree-study](https://www.boca.gov.tw/cp-166-283-c4da3-2.html) and [Mandarin-study guidance](https://www.boca.gov.tw/fp-158-260-9690c-2.html) set different entry conditions for students.

Nationality and the passport used determine visa eligibility. The [Taiwan overseas mission handling your application](https://www.boca.gov.tw/sp-foof-countrylp-01-2.html) provides the nationality-specific requirements and document procedures.

## Permission for a visit and permission to reside

A temporary visitor's permitted activities and length of stay depend on the entry arrangement granted. A longer move requires a residence basis, such as employment, study or joining family. BOCA's [resident-visa guidance](https://www.boca.gov.tw/cp-165-1878-1ff5e-2.html) covers those purposes, while the National Immigration Agency (NIA) decides residence applications and issues the Alien Resident Certificate (ARC).

Some eligible visitors can apply directly to NIA. Other applicants need the appropriate visa before entry, so arriving as a visitor leaves no general right to convert a short stay into residence.

## An employment offer is the start of the application

For most foreign professional hires, the employer applies for a work permit, subject to statutory exceptions and the authority responsible for the job. [Articles 4 and 5 of the Act for the Recruitment and Employment of Foreign Professionals](https://law.moj.gov.tw/ENG/LawClass/LawAll.aspx?pcode=A0030295) define professional work and the permit framework. A signed offer is not work authorization.

Once a qualifying foreign professional or foreign specialist professional has the permit or an applicable exemption, Article 16 allows a direct residence application following visa-exempt or visitor-visa entry. NIA must still approve the residence application before issuing an ARC. The current Article 16 took effect on January 1, 2026, as recorded in the Act's [legislative history](https://law.moj.gov.tw/ENG/LawClass/LawHistory.aspx?pcode=A0030295).

[NIA's guide](https://www.immigration.gov.tw/5475/5478/141465/141808/141824/cp_news) excludes trial visa exemptions, the Southeast Asian online travel-authorization scheme and other listed entry arrangements from this direct-application route unless another rule applies, even where the applicant holds work approval.

Care work, fishing and other migrant-worker categories under [Employment Service Act Article 46](https://law.moj.gov.tw/ENG/LawClass/LawAll.aspx?pcode=N0090001) have their own rules. NIA's [migrant-worker residence procedure](https://www.immigration.gov.tw/5382/5385/7244/7250/7317/%E5%B1%85%E7%95%99/181964/) applies to those categories; employment in Taiwan does not by itself place a worker within the foreign-professional scheme. The category on the work approval identifies which procedure to use.

## Degree students and Mandarin learners

Full-time foreign students applying from abroad can seek a resident visa at a Taiwan overseas mission. Those who enter on a visitor visa specifically for foreign-student study may apply directly to NIA for residence. The ordinary in-country study route in [BOCA's student guidance](https://www.boca.gov.tw/cp-166-283-c4da3-2.html) excludes visa-exempt entry, landing visas and visitor visas issued for other purposes.

Depending on the application, BOCA also requires educational records, financial evidence and a health certificate alongside the admission letter; the program's checklist determines which overseas records need authentication.

For Mandarin learners, the [language-study visitor visa](https://www.boca.gov.tw/fp-158-260-9690c-2.html) ordinarily comes before arrival. Eligibility for residence follows four completed months at a qualifying university-affiliated center, with registration for at least three more months. [BOCA's Mandarin residence guidance](https://www.boca.gov.tw/fp-166-285-041cb-2.html) requires at least 15 classroom hours a week, Monday through Friday. Absences, including leave, may not exceed one quarter of class hours. Tuition payment alone does not establish eligibility.

Can a student take a part-time job? [Employment Service Act Articles 43 and 50](https://law.moj.gov.tw/ENG/LawClass/LawAll.aspx?pcode=N0090001) govern work permits and specified student employment. The admission letter and student ARC do not replace the work authorization needed for the job.

## Joining a spouse or parent in Taiwan

Family residence depends on the sponsor's status and the relationship. For a spouse of a Taiwan national residing in Taiwan with household registration, one in-country route under [Immigration Act Article 23](https://law.moj.gov.tw/LawClass/LawSingle.aspx?pcode=D0080132&flno=23) requires a valid visa allowing a stay of at least 60 days and without the specified restrictions. Marriage therefore does not establish a general right to convert visa-exempt entry to residence. The required relationship documents and related status issues appear in [residence through a Taiwan spouse](/en/columns/taiwan-foreign-spouse-residence).

When a foreign professional engaged in professional work in Taiwan or a foreign specialist professional already has approved residence or permanent residence, [Article 16](https://law.moj.gov.tw/ENG/LawClass/LawAll.aspx?pcode=A0030295) allows certain family members to apply directly after visa-exempt or visitor-visa entry. It covers a spouse, minor children, and adult children unable to care for themselves because of physical or mental disability. Parents and other adult children are excluded.

Work rights vary by family category. [Employment Service Act Article 48](https://law.moj.gov.tw/ENG/LawClass/LawAll.aspx?pcode=N0090001) provides a work-permit exemption for an approved resident married to a Taiwan national with household registration. Dependent spouses of foreign professionals cannot assume that exemption applies to them. For qualifying spouses of specialist or senior professionals, [Foreign Professionals Act Article 15](https://law.moj.gov.tw/ENG/LawClass/LawAll.aspx?pcode=A0030295) provides a direct application for a work permit.

## Gold Cards, founders and longer visits

Specialist professionals who meet the program's criteria may qualify for an [Employment Gold Card](https://goldcard.nat.gov.tw/en/), which combines work, residence, visa and re-entry functions in one document. The [Gold Card article](/en/columns/taiwan-employment-gold-card) covers that application separately.

BOCA publishes the [entrepreneur route requirements](https://www.boca.gov.tw/lp-154-2.html) for applicants planning to establish a business in Taiwan.

Working-holiday access depends on the [nationality-specific program](https://www.boca.gov.tw/lp-153-2.html). The [digital-nomad visitor visa](https://www.boca.gov.tw/cp-158-7718-c0382-2.html) has separate nationality and qualification requirements and does not automatically lead to an ARC. [Foreign Professionals Act Article 14](https://law.moj.gov.tw/ENG/LawClass/LawAll.aspx?pcode=A0030295) limits that remote-work route to qualifying work without providing services to Taiwan businesses or employers.

Once the residence category and entry requirements are established, the [first ARC application guide](/en/columns/taiwan-arc-first-application) covers filing and collection. An existing resident moving to a new job, course or family basis also needs the [rules on renewal and changes](/en/columns/taiwan-arc-renewal-changes-reentry): the current card does not settle whether that new purpose qualifies.

Sources checked October 24, 2026. Eligibility still depends on the individual application. These routes concern foreign nationals; Mainland China residents, Hong Kong and Macau residents, and ROC nationals without household registration follow separate frameworks.

## Official sources

- [Act for the Recruitment and Employment of Foreign Professionals](https://law.moj.gov.tw/ENG/LawClass/LawAll.aspx?pcode=A0030295), Articles 4, 5, 14, 15 and 16; [legislative history](https://law.moj.gov.tw/ENG/LawClass/LawHistory.aspx?pcode=A0030295).
- [Immigration Act, Article 23](https://law.moj.gov.tw/LawClass/LawSingle.aspx?pcode=D0080132&flno=23): qualifying in-country residence routes.
- [Employment Service Act](https://law.moj.gov.tw/ENG/LawClass/LawAll.aspx?pcode=N0090001), Articles 43, 46, 48 and 50: work categories, permits, exemptions and student work.
- BOCA: [resident visas](https://www.boca.gov.tw/cp-165-1878-1ff5e-2.html), [foreign students](https://www.boca.gov.tw/cp-166-283-c4da3-2.html), [Mandarin visitor visas](https://www.boca.gov.tw/fp-158-260-9690c-2.html), [Mandarin residence](https://www.boca.gov.tw/fp-166-285-041cb-2.html).
- [NIA, residence applications after visitor-visa or visa-exempt entry](https://www.immigration.gov.tw/5475/5478/141465/141808/141824/cp_news), note 7(1), updated April 14, 2026: excluded entry arrangements and exceptions under other applicable rules.
- [NIA, migrant-worker residence applications](https://www.immigration.gov.tw/5382/5385/7244/7250/7317/%E5%B1%85%E7%95%99/181964/).
- Official [Employment Gold Card information](https://goldcard.nat.gov.tw/en/) and [BOCA entrepreneur materials](https://www.boca.gov.tw/lp-154-2.html).
- BOCA, [working-holiday programs](https://www.boca.gov.tw/lp-153-2.html) and [digital-nomad visitor visa](https://www.boca.gov.tw/cp-158-7718-c0382-2.html).
- [Taiwan overseas mission directory](https://www.boca.gov.tw/sp-foof-countrylp-01-2.html): relevant consular offices.
